content_sections.heading: About Karnataka H&FWS
content_sections.text: The Commissionerate, Health and Family Welfare Services (H&FWS) is a Government of Karnataka body. Its office is at Arogya Soudha, Magadi Road, Bengaluru. These posts serve the Karnataka Brain Health Initiative (KaBHI) Program of H&FWS. The notification is issued from the Mental Health section (reference DD-Mental Health) and is signed by the Commissioner, Health & Family Welfare Services, Bengaluru.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notification lists a single designation with 2 posts. It gives no category-wise break-up and no place of posting.

rows.designation: Neurologist or Physician or Medical Officer

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The desirable experience printed in the notice is: MD/DNB: 2 years' experience in working with neurological diseases. MBBS: experience in treating neurological disease. A candidate with similar past experience is preferable. Candidates with relevant experience in a similar role will be preferred. Other eligibility conditions in the notice: The prescribed course must be full-time and completed at a recognized university. Speaking, reading and writing Kannada is mandatory. Age limit: The age limit is 60 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. For the full eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The salary is a consolidated amount per month, and it depends on the qualification the candidate holds: The positions are temporary and purely contractual. The notice does not mention the length of the contract, allowances or an extension.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Karnataka H&FWS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are submitted offline, using the prescribed form in the notification's Annexure. Download the prescribed application form given in the Annexure of the notification. Fill in the form with your name and address in block letters, the post applied for, date of birth, qualifications, employment details in chronological order, details of experience (supported by relevant documents), any additional information on your suitability, and remarks. Sign and date the form. If the space for employment details or additional information is not enough, enclose a separate sheet. A separate sheet for employment details must be authenticated with your signature. Attach two self-attested photocopies of each document listed under Documents Required. Submit the application by post or in person to: Mental Health Section, 6th Floor west wing, Arogya Soudha, Magadi Road, Bengaluru – 560023. For in-person submission, go during working hours (10:00 AM – 5:30 PM). Selection: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified of the interview via email, and no communication will be sent to other applicants. The notice does not give the interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Enclose two self-attested photocopies of each of the following: Educational qualification certificates Experience certificates, wherever applicable Recent passport-size photograph Valid photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving License or Voter ID) Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: This is a rolling recruitment notification with no fixed closing date. No further applications will be accepted after all vacancies are filled. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. For queries, contact 080-23295616 during office hours. The competent authority reserves the right to reject any or all applications, or to cancel the notification, at any stage without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Karnataka H&FWS Recruitment 2026 under KaBHI?
faq.answer: There are 2 contractual positions for Neurologist / Physician / Medical Officer under the Karnataka Brain Health Initiative (KaBHI).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: There is no fixed closing date. This is a rolling recruitment that stays open until all vacancies are filled, after which no further applications will be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is DM/DNB Neurology or MD/DNB General Medicine or MBBS. The course must be full-time and completed at a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 60 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Neurologist / Physician / Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs 1,50,000/- per month for DM/DNB Neurology, Rs 1,10,000/- for MD/DNB General Medicine and Rs 60,000/- for MBBS.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form in the Annexure and attach two self-attested photocopies of the required documents. Submit it by post or in person to Mental Health Section, 6th Floor west wing, Arogya Soudha, Magadi Road, Bengaluru – 560023, during working hours (10:00 AM – 5:30 PM).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email.

faq.question: Q8. Is knowledge of Kannada required?
faq.answer: Yes. Speaking, reading and writing Kannada is mandatory.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The positions are temporary and purely contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
